name: ibo
oneLine: Open source Canny: feedback board, roadmap, changelog, with MCP for agents.
blurb: open source canny alternative. collect feedback from your users, let them vote on features and see your roadmap and changelog. built for agents too, app is usable via mcp

name: Brandon Theriot
oneLine: Granola replacement where every AI note line plays its source moment.
blurb: Meeting notes with receipts: a Granola replacement where every AI-written line links to, and plays, the exact moment it was said. Runs in your browser. Free with your own key.

name: Hauke Jung
oneLine: Self-hosted Sentry replacement in Rust; agents triage issues over MCP.
blurb: Thermite: a self-hosted error tracker that speaks Sentry's wire protocol and serves every issue over MCP, so your coding agent triages production bugs with the same view you have. Rust, one binary.

name: Aleksandar Jovanovic
oneLine: TrustMRR-style public user-growth leaderboard with read-only source connectors.
blurb: TrustMRR for tracking and showing how many user you have and how active they are. Great motivation if you have no sales yet.

name: Umer farooq
oneLine: Mobile console for local coding agents; replaces remote terminal tools.
blurb: muxr puts every local coding agent on your phone. See what's Working, what Needs you, and what's Done-then open the exact live terminal, prompt the same session, review the diff, or talk it through.

name: Jeremy lasne
oneLine: Personal knowledge filer with cited answers; replaces Readwise or Mem.
blurb: A knowledge organization. Drop compiles each source once into concepts, every claim signed with its author and date. Ask reads those concepts to answer you.

name: Max Reid
oneLine: Keyboard-driven market terminal with live indices, FX and commodities; replaces a Bloomberg-style terminal.
blurb: Keyboard-driven market terminal with live indices, FX and commodities.

name: Priyesh Pandey
oneLine: Browser caption editor with animated presets; replaces Submagic and Captions.
blurb: Turn any video into styled, animated captions. Pick a preset (Hormozi, MrBeast, Neon...), drag/scale live, auto camera punch-ins, edit every word, export MP4/SRT/VTT, all in-browser.

name: aidan tan
oneLine: Mac meeting app with live captions and screen captures; Granola alternative.
blurb: Inspired by Granola, but build for visual learners. Excerpt, is a free Mac app, with movie-style live captions, visual captures that go straight to your notes, along with other cool features.

name: Andrii Solokh
oneLine: Free 3D dot-connection puzzle in the browser; replaces paid puzzle apps.
blurb: Free browser alternative to paid logic puzzle apps: solve generated 2D/3D connection boards with touch or keyboard, hints, saved progress, and three character editions.

name: Novak Blagojevic
oneLine: Browser 3D device mockups from screenshots; replaces Rotato or Mockuuups.
blurb: Turn screenshots into studio-lit 3D device mockups. Customize the angle, lighting and background, then export PNG. Free, no account. Your images stay in your browser.

name: Vanya Belomestov
oneLine: Game that flies your real X replies as paper planes to recipients.
blurb: Airmail: fly your real X replies as paper planes to the people you wrote. AI reads each reply into a letter; storms form where X argues. Endless free flight, a daily leaderboard, ranks.

name: Youssef Mohamed
oneLine: Private browser screenshot beautifier; replaces Xnapper, Shots.so, CleanShot.
blurb: Free, private Xnapper/Shots.so replacement: paste a screenshot, get backgrounds, window frames, real 3D tilt, arrows, redaction & social sizes. Zero deps, all in your browser.

name: tobias
oneLine: Joke one-page store selling thumbs-up photos; spec-driven zero-dependency build.
blurb: Ok Rich is an e-commerce store for terrible investments: You pay me money to make me rich and I will send you one (1) real, custom thumbs-up photo as a gesture of goodwill. That's it.

name: NOUREDDINE RATBAOUI
oneLine: Phone-sensor workout arcade; your body controls 3D browser games.
blurb: InMotion, an immersive workout fun experience to play games with your body. Your body is the controller, No camera detection just your phone sensors. The idea was inspired by a viral challenge.
